# Albus

> Albus runs agent sessions over an HTTP API. You send a prompt and an agent
> configuration; Albus executes the model loop, connects the MCP servers you
> declare, and returns the assistant's reply. Private beta: invite-only, 20
> session runs per organization.

## Agent Instructions

If you are a coding agent setting Albus up or writing code against it, read
https://docs.albus.sh/agents/docs.md first — it is self-contained: setup, the
whole API surface, the rules, and runnable examples. Every page below is also
available as Markdown at the same URL with `.md` appended.

## Start here

- [Albus for coding agents](https://docs.albus.sh/agents/docs.md): One page — setup, the whole API surface, the rules, and runnable examples.
- [Introduction](https://docs.albus.sh/index.md): What Albus does and the shortest path to a first session.
- [Request access](https://docs.albus.sh/getting-started/access.md): Get an account enabled for the private beta.
- [Install](https://docs.albus.sh/getting-started/install.md): Install the CLI or an SDK, and the runtimes each needs.
- [Authenticate](https://docs.albus.sh/getting-started/authenticate.md): Sign in, or mint an organization API key for scripts and CI.
- [Run your first session](https://docs.albus.sh/getting-started/first-session.md): Run one session with the CLI, Python, TypeScript, or curl.
- [Set up your coding agent](https://docs.albus.sh/getting-started/for-your-agent.md): Have a coding agent install Albus and write your integration.

## Guides

- [Run a session](https://docs.albus.sh/guides/run-a-session.md): Run a turn, wait for the reply, resume the conversation, and retry safely.
- [Secrets](https://docs.albus.sh/guides/secrets.md): Store a credential and reference it from an agent configuration.
- [MCP servers](https://docs.albus.sh/guides/mcp-servers.md): Give an agent tools by declaring MCP servers.
- [Model providers](https://docs.albus.sh/guides/model-providers.md): Run a session on your own model provider account.
- [Agents and revisions](https://docs.albus.sh/guides/agents-and-revisions.md): Trace a run back to the exact agent configuration that produced it.
- [Audit log](https://docs.albus.sh/guides/audit-log.md): Find out what happened inside a run.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.albus.sh/guides/troubleshooting.md): Match an error to its cause and its fix.

## Reference

- [CLI](https://docs.albus.sh/reference/cli.md): Every `albus` command, flag, and environment variable.
- [SDKs](https://docs.albus.sh/reference/sdks.md): The Python and TypeScript clients — install, auth, responses, errors.
- [Errors](https://docs.albus.sh/reference/errors.md): Every status code, its body, and the fix.
- [API reference](https://docs.albus.sh/reference/overview.md): The generated HTTP contract and playground.
- [Release policy](https://docs.albus.sh/guides/releases.md): How the docs track deployed releases.

## Private beta

- [Limitations](https://docs.albus.sh/beta/limitations.md): Quota, memory, execution, and observability limits.
- [Support](https://docs.albus.sh/beta/support.md): How to reach us, and what to include.
